data.name: MODUSCopActiveTitle
data.value: MODUS Cop is active

data.name: MODUSCopActiveMessageFormat
data.value: MODUS Cop active.

data.name: MODUSCopActiveDescription
data.value: Reports that MODUS Cop is active at the id property of the app manifest.

data.name: CompositeKeyTableRequiresFilterAndFindRecordTitle
data.value: Composite-key tables require FilterRecord and FindRecord

data.name: CompositeKeyTableRequiresFilterAndFindRecordMessageFormat
data.value: Table '{0}' with multiple primary-key fields must implement FilterRecord() and FindRecord() procedures.

data.name: CompositeKeyTableRequiresFilterAndFindRecordDescription
data.value: Normal tables with a composite primary key must provide both FilterRecord and FindRecord procedures.

data.name: SetupTableRequiresReadAndInitializeTitle
data.value: Setup tables require Read and Initialize

data.name: SetupTableRequiresReadAndInitializeMessageFormat
data.value: Setup table '{0}' must implement Read() and Initialize() procedures.

data.name: SetupTableRequiresReadAndInitializeDescription
data.value: Tables matching the shared setup-table heuristic whose names contain Setup must provide both Read and Initialize procedures.

data.name: IdentifierNameConflictsWithTypeNameTitle
data.value: Identifier name conflicts with type name

data.name: IdentifierNameConflictsWithTypeNameMessageFormat
data.value: Identifier '{0}' conflicts with the type name '{1}'.

data.name: IdentifierNameConflictsWithTypeNameDescription
data.value: Global and local variable names must not conflict with the name of their declared data type.

data.name: SetupTableAccessRequiresReadOrInitializeTitle
data.value: Use Read or Initialize to access setup tables

data.name: SetupTableAccessRequiresReadOrInitializeMessageFormat
data.value: Use Read() or Initialize() to read setup table '{0}'.

data.name: SetupTableAccessRequiresReadOrInitializeDescription
data.value: Use a Read or Initialize procedure instead of Get, Find, FindFirst, FindLast, or FindSet when the setup table supplies either procedure. Access to the owning table within its own Read or Initialize procedure is exempt.

data.name: PageExtensionActionPromotionTitle
data.value: Do not promote actions in page extensions

data.name: PageExtensionActionPromotionMessageFormat
data.value: Action promotion is not allowed in page extensions.

data.name: PageExtensionActionPromotionDescription
data.value: Added page-extension actions must not declare Promoted, even when false, or use action references.

data.name: PageExtensionActionPlacementTitle
data.value: Use AddLast for page-extension actions

data.name: PageExtensionActionPlacementMessageFormat
data.value: AddFirst, AddBefore, AddAfter, MoveFirst, MoveLast, MoveBefore, and MoveAfter are not allowed for actions in page extensions. Use AddLast instead or omit the move.

data.name: PageExtensionActionPlacementDescription
data.value: Page-extension action additions must use AddLast and existing actions must not be moved. Control changes are unaffected.

data.name: MandatoryAffixOnlyInExtensionObjectsTitle
data.value: Use mandatory affixes only in extension objects

data.name: MandatoryAffixOnlyInExtensionObjectsMessageFormat
data.value: Affix '{0}' must only be used in extension objects.

data.name: MandatoryAffixOnlyInExtensionObjectsDescription
data.value: Names of members in non-extension objects must not contain the mandatory affixes configured in AppSourceCop.json.
